mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_release_shadow_run(shadow_run_id, run_no, baseline_release_id, candidate_release_id, status, sample_target, sample_count, started_time, completed_time, allow_to_review_count, allow_to_deny_count, deny_to_allow_count, action_change_count, feature_missing_count, failed_count, timed_out_count, p95_millis, p99_millis, check_status, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.shadowRunId}, #{row.runNo}, #{row.baselineReleaseId}, #{row.candidateReleaseId}, #{row.status}, #{row.sampleTarget}, #{row.sampleCount}, #{row.startedTime}, #{row.completedTime}, #{row.allowToReviewCount}, #{row.allowToDenyCount}, #{row.denyToAllowCount}, #{row.actionChangeCount}, #{row.featureMissingCount}, #{row.failedCount}, #{row.timedOutCount}, #{row.p95Millis}, #{row.p99Millis}, #{row.checkStatus}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
